<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the chalcone SMILES as the target molecule and specify the functional groups and bond changes described in the reaction (ketone and aromatic hydroxyl broken, ether oxygen formed, C‑C and C‑O bonds formed, C‑O bond broken). This should return the template ID and its mapped reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(C=Cc1ccccc1)C(C)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "aromatic_hydroxyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether_oxygen"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
